name: 舒展光纤街树

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. One four-unit tall cyberpunk street tree sculpture: narrow dark silver organic branching trunk, gently spreading asymmetrical crown of connected thick blue-cyan fiber sprays with occasional soft rose tips, open lower trunk, airy legible silhouette, subtly translucent surfaces but solid geometry. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately

visualReview.notes: 分层冠与连接枝干完整，纤维喷束被简化为密集冠簇。
